title: Security Brand Experiences
summary: Brand foundations that connect the website, product story, and the teams using them.
overview: At Secureframe, I led the website overhaul and created a Canva-based brand system that gave marketing and sales a consistent starting point. At AppOmni, I built reusable page components and worked with content, development, and QA to bring them into production.

outcomes.label: Secureframe landing-page conversion, with content and demand gen

blocks.title: How the system scaled
blocks.body: The AppOmni work extended beyond individual pages. I developed reusable component, product-visualization, and motion workflows that helped carry design intent into repeatable production.
